raw_text: Ransomware Tracker Entry #RT-2022-4891: Victim: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, India. Sector: Healthcare. Attack vector: Phishing email leading to lateral movement. Ransomware family: Modified Wanna Cry variant with custom encryption module. Ransom demanded: 200 BTC (~$3.4M USD). Data volume: ~1.3 TB across 5 servers. Status: Systems offline, recovery in progress. Notable: Patient PII including Aadhaar numbers potentially exfiltrated prior to encryption.
